text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/` and didn't touch the tests. I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell tool here, so I checked each fix by reading it against its test. None of this has been run yet.

- **`fees.py`**: the fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying, so it now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3; it's now 5, which is what the tests and the policy comment say.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: the sample data was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`; the tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as text, so it now converts it to an int.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports it from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
